newsitem.title: USA: E.W. Scripps Nov consolidated revs rise.
newsitem.headline: E.W. Scripps Nov consolidated revs rise.

text.p: E.W. Scripps Co said on Wednesday its consolidated revenues rose 14.3 percent in November to $108.3 million compared to $94.7 million in the same period last year.
The company said newspaper advertising revenues for the month were $46.1 million, up 8.5 percent, and total newspaper revenues rose 6.5 percent to $61.8 million.
Revenues from the television station group increased 7.7 percent to $31.7 million, the company said.
Political advertising in November totaled $3.4 million compared to $1.0 million in the year-ago month, it said.
Year-to-date political advertising was $19.5 million through November 1996 compared to $2.6 million through November 1995, Scripps said.
In the entertainment division, revenues jumped to $14.7 million from $7.2 million last year, due to strong growth in all the division's businesses.
